profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineering Professional | Specializing in Supply Chain & IT Solutions

Results-driven software engineer with over 22 years of experience in Information Technology and 16+ years in management and supervision. Adept at software architecture, project management, and system implementations, with a strong focus on supply chain solutions, WMS development, and server administration.
Key Specialties:

    Supply Chain & Logistics Technology: WMS Implementations & Development, Operations Logistics, SenPro Enterprise Programming.
    Software Engineering & Development: SQL Programming (SQL 2008, 2012, 2016, 2019), Crystal Reports, SSRS, Loftware Client, Webwise.
    Database & Server Administration: SQL Database Administration, Apache Tomcat, Server Administration.
    Project & System Management: Software Architecture, IT Project Management, Software Analysis.

Professional Strengths:

    Proven ability to design, develop, and implement innovative software solutions for enterprise-level organizations, including major financial institutions.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and research skills with a keen eye for detail.
    Skilled in prioritization, project coordination, and leading cross-functional teams.
    Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills, excelling in both independent and collaborative environments.
    Ability to perform under high-pressure conditions while maintaining focus on quality and efficiency.
    Fluent in English and Spanish, enabling seamless communication in diverse business environments.

Passionate about leveraging technology to drive operational efficiency and business success. Always eager to master new technologies through hands-on experience and continuous learning.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer with end-to-end ownership of enterprise Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and SendPro Enterprise (SPE) supporting thousands of global users. Drive high-availability design, operations, and modernization across heterogeneous Windows Server (2003–2022) and SQL Server (2000–2022) estates, ensuring platform health, uptime, and scalable performance. Lead reliability and lifecycle management for WMS (Warehouse Advantage, Supplier Advantage, Delivery Advantage) and SPE, including proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis for critical outages and degradations.

Oversee operational readiness for large device fleets (900+ RF handhelds and 100+ label printers), managing provisioning, troubleshooting, repair logistics, and service continuity. Build and maintain deployment pipelines and development environments leveraging IIS, Tomcat, and Microsoft tooling, while executing software upgrades, application rollouts, and cross-business integration initiatives. Serve as a key liaison between internal engineering teams and vendor consultants (Körber and Pitney Bowes) to deliver custom solutions and resolve complex production issues. Develop in-house SQL Server solutions for access control, data integrity, and user provisioning, translating business process artifacts (flowcharts, decision tables) into reliable, validated software implementations. Manage a $1.5M+ annual WMS/SPE budget, optimizing contracts, services, and infrastructure investments.
positions.insights: Information Technology, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and +22 skills

positions.title: Application Support Specialist- WMS
positions.description:
Setup, configure and deploy Windows 2003, 2008 Standard and Enterprise Servers.
Setup, configure, manage and deploy Windows 2000, 2008 Development server for WMS.
Create user logins on SQL DB and do maintenance backup. Assist DBA’s on installing and configuring SQL servers. Support Application to configure SQL client.
Experience Installing, Configuring and Supporting SQL Server Databases and Applications.
Setup IIS, create, manage and troubleshoot Websites.
Setup, configure, manage and deploy Apache Tomcat.
Contact HighJump Software for Website support and problem solving.
Maintain user’s menu level access to facilitate access to each user group in their role.
Responsible for over 400 RF gun inventory including: set up, troubleshoot and fix or send out to be repaired of all RF guns to assure their availability and readiness.
Manages the appropriate operation of the Warehouse Management Systems (Warehouse Advantage, Supplier Advantage, Logistic, Delivery Advantage, Delivery Advantage Edge2, Warehouse Advantage OS, Loftware Print Server and Crystal Report).
Create new users in WMS when required by department supervisors and managers.
Manage and support new application and WebWise changes.
Responsible for testing new applications, upgrades and implement to production environment.
Interact and communicate with Innovation Solutions (HighJump Consultant) and resolve any outstanding issues with new change orders or new releases.
Translate Broadridge flow charts, decision tables or other instructions into appropriate computer language; make trial runs to verify accuracy and completeness of program; correct program errors by altering program steps and sequence as required.
Install and maintain database software for departmental users; set up new computer systems when appropriate.
Managed $900,000 WMS budget including maintenance contract, professional services, and hardware purchases.

positions.title: WMS Administrator
positions.description:
Gathered requirements, configured, and implemented warehouse layout to include proper put-away classes, forward pick locations and picking rules. Responsible for resolving issues with WMS vendor, implementation of all upgrades to software, change orders, and new modules for the system. Communicated key project information and resolved issues. Identified potential problems and took preventive measures by researching and analyzing historical data. Provided day to day support for WMS; maintained the integrity of the scanning and bar coding equipment. Trained all associates and temporary staff in the entire production operations department on WMS. 

50% increase in productivity created through efforts.
